chunks: 5170 - Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus, from Abū Ḥamzah, from one of the two Imams عليهما السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was approached, and it was said: “O Messenger of Allah, there is a slain man in Juhaynah.” So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله stood up and went until he reached their mosque, and the people heard of it and came to him. Then he عليه السلام said: “Who killed this one?” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, we do not know.”

He said: “A slain man from among the Muslims, in the midst of the Muslims, and it is not known who killed him? By the One who sent me with the truth, if the people of the heaven and the people of the earth were to gather together, participate in the blood of a Muslim man, and approve of it, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, would cast them down upon their noses into the Fire.”

key_terms.بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَيِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: in the midst of the Muslims; among the Muslim community
key_terms.جُهَيْنَةَ: Juhaynah, the tribe or locality where the incident occurred
key_terms.دَمِ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ: the blood of a Muslim person, meaning unlawful killing
key_terms.قَتِيلٌ: a slain person; one who has been killed
key_terms.مَسْجِدِهِمْ: their mosque, the place the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله went to investigate

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about the sanctity of a Muslim’s blood and the sin of approving murder?
ai.summary: This hadith shows the grave sanctity of Muslim life and the severe condemnation of unlawful bloodshed. It emphasizes that not only direct participation in murder, but even approval of it, incurs terrible punishment before Allah عز وجل.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5170 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Mansur ibn Yunus from Abu Hamzah from one of the two Imams (as), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (swt) was approached, and it was said to Him (sw): "O' Messenger of Allah (swt), there has been a murder in Juhaynah."
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) stood up and went to their mosque. The people heard about it and gathered around him.
Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Who killed this man?"
They replied: "O' Messenger of Allah (swt), we do not know."

Prophet (sw) said: "A Muslim has been killed among the Muslims, and no one knows who killed him? By the One (swt) who sent Me (sw) with the truth, if the people of the heavens and the people of the earth were to come together and participate in the shedding of a Muslim's blood and were pleased with it, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, would surely cast them all down on their faces - or He (swt) said, on their noses - into the Fire."
